The proposed answer is wrong. Step 5 claims $4193821$ is prime, but it factors:

$$4193821 = 1471 \times 2851$$

Check: $1471 \times 2851 = 1471 \times 2800 + 1471 \times 51 = 4118800 + 75021 = 4193821$.

Both factors are prime. $1471$ has no prime factor up to $\sqrt{1471} \approx 38$, and $2851$ has no prime factor up to $\sqrt{2851} \approx 53$. Both are $\equiv 1 \pmod 5$, consistent with the order argument in Step 4. The trial-division list in Step 5 missed $1471$ and $2851$ (the bound was also wrong: $2851 > 2047$).

The factorization of the full expression is $45^5 - 1 = 2^2 \cdot 11 \cdot 1471 \cdot 2851$, so the largest prime factor is $2851$, not $4193821$.

VERDICT: REJECT
CONFIDENCE: 5
